name: Correlation Trace by CorrelationId
description: Trace all logs for a specific correlation ID across services

name: Saga Flow Tracking
query: @Level IN ['Information', 'Warning', 'Error'] AND (@Properties.CorrelationId != '' OR @Properties.EventType IN ['OrderPlacedEvent', 'ShipmentCreatedEvent', 'ShipmentDeliveredEvent', 'InvoiceGeneratedEvent', 'PaymentConfirmedEvent', 'OrderStatusChangedEvent']) | select @Timestamp, @Level, @MessageTemplate, @Properties.CorrelationId, @Properties.EventType, @Properties.ServiceName | orderby @Timestamp asc

name: Messaging Errors & Retries
query: @Level IN ['Warning', 'Error'] AND (@MessageTemplate LIKE '%retry%' OR @MessageTemplate LIKE '%DLQ%' OR @MessageTemplate LIKE '%failed%') | select @Timestamp, @Level, @MessageTemplate, @Properties.CorrelationId, @Properties.EventType, @Properties.RetryCount | orderby @Timestamp desc
description: All messaging failures, retries, and dead-letter events

name: Outbox Processing
query: @Level IN ['Information', 'Warning', 'Error'] AND @MessageTemplate LIKE '%outbox%' | select @Timestamp, @Level, @MessageTemplate, @Properties.CorrelationId, @Properties.EventType | orderby @Timestamp desc
description: Outbox message persistence and publishing activity

name: Service Health Check Failures
query: @Level IN ['Warning', 'Error'] AND @MessageTemplate LIKE '%health%' | select @Timestamp, @Level, @MessageTemplate, @Properties.ServiceName | orderby @Timestamp desc
description: Health check failures across all services

name: Slow HTTP Requests (>1s)
query: @Level IN ['Information', 'Warning'] AND @Properties.RequestPath != '' AND @Properties.ElapsedMilliseconds > 1000 | select @Timestamp, @Level, @MessageTemplate, @Properties.RequestMethod, @Properties.RequestPath, @Properties.ElapsedMilliseconds, @Properties.CorrelationId | orderby @Properties.ElapsedMilliseconds desc
description: Slow HTTP requests with correlation IDs
